params.prompt: Use the exact art style, camera and finish of the first reference image. The student is the character of the second reference image and the cat is the one of the third. In-game screenshot of the upper floor of a hillside house in a tropical port city, seen from the fixed high top-down three-quarter gameplay camera pitched steeply down about 60 degrees, exactly like the gameplay reference image: no horizon and no sky, the ground fills the entire frame, characters about one eighth of the image height. Dollhouse cutaway: the roof is removed and every wall is cut down to waist height with clean cut tops, so the whole floor plan reads clearly from above. The bedroom-workshop fills most of the frame: a single bed with a cardboard box beside it, a window opening toward the colorful hillside stair neighborhood, a small white refractor telescope on a tripod, and a wooden workbench with the motorized Moon tracker she built (a small homemade two-axis mount with two stepper motors, a small camera, a bare circuit board and loose wires), a vintage oscilloscope with a wobbly cyan trace and an open engineering notebook with ink sketches. A doorway leads to a short hallway with family photos and the top of a wooden staircase that descends toward the ground-floor kitchen, partly visible below through the stairwell. the chibi engineering student with voluminous dark curly hair, warm brown skin, a khaki short-sleeve utility jacket over a dark t-shirt, khaki cargo pants, chunky navy-and-white sneakers and a brown crossbody tool bag walks from the bed toward the workbench and the small gray-taupe companion cat with a cream face mask, cream chest and paws, a dark tail tip and a blue collar with a glowing cyan round tag trots ahead of her. Terracotta floor tiles, woven rugs, potted plants, a ceiling fan seen from above. Warm morning sun from the windows casts long shafts across the floor, cool petrol-blue shade along the cut walls. Polished 2D-HD presentation: a soft tilt-shift depth of field that gently blurs the nearest and farthest edges of the frame and keeps the middle crisp, soft volumetric light shafts, gentle bloom, a subtle vignette; painted light where the shade stays soft and colored, never black. Art style: stylized low-poly 3D exactly like the reference images, crisp faceted flat-shaded planes with a hand-painted gradient on each facet, cel-shaded lighting with a bright rim light, chunky simplified forms, clean readable silhouettes, matte materials, palette of cream, terracotta, tropical green, petrol blue and warm wood browns, with cyan reserved for technology, data and collectibles. No text, no logos, no interface.
